name: synapsidian-dock
description: Dock add-on for the synapsidian plugin: /synapsidian shows a band above the prompt with what is overdue, due today and in progress, with a Tasks button to a pane whose keys close, start, move or drop a task without a Claude turn. A Claude Code mod; needs Claude Code 2.1.299 or later.

show_dock_band.title: Show the band above the prompt
show_dock_band.description: Show the band above the prompt (what is overdue, due today and in progress, and a Tasks button) as soon as a session starts. Off (the default), it shows when you run /synapsidian.
